Command.Statement: WITH MEMBER [Measures].[Sqft] AS [Store].CurrentMember.Properties("Store Sqft") MEMBER [Measures].[Coffee] AS [Store].CurrentMember.Properties("has coffee bar") MEMBER [Measures].[Sqft + 1] AS [Store].CurrentMember.Properties("Store Sqft") + 1 SELECT {[Measures].[Sqft], [Measures].[Coffee], [Measures].[Sqft + 1]} ON 0, {[Store].[USA].[CA].[San Francisco].Children, [Store].[USA].[CA], [Store].[All Stores]} ON 1 FROM [ZFMSALES]
